bayts.text: O best of guests, come with joy and (spiritual) aid: welcome, be at ease, and a greeting beyond number!
May you ever remain a noble guest who visits, honoured with the hospitable feast of acts of obedience and uprightness,
magnified with a Lord Who has no partner, and with the people of piety, knowledge and right guidance.
May you remain the effacer of burdens, the fulfiller of wishes and the banisher of otherness from the soul.
the one who chains every satan with all he has, and who bestows gifts upon the people of excellence.
and the one who removes every sorrow by which, through time, we are straitened in our hearts, O you who remove adversity!
and the one who increases every year what we win from the bounty of an Enricher, Generous, Benefactor of increase.
O month of a Generous Lord, Who in you bestowed upon us the Night of Destiny (Laylat al-Qadr), possessed of excellence and abundance!
Truly I love you with an intimate love, asking my Master, in you, for a felicity without crookedness,
repentant too in you, ever proceeding with remembrance, gratitude and the Qurʾān for the One.
To Him I repented in Shaʿbān, after Rajab, renewing myself in you: so bear witness for me to my forsaking of frivolous play.
Bear witness for me that I took up the Book of Allah in you, here, until my departure, on Saturday and Sunday.
And bear witness to my loving you with an intimate love, O my hope, and be my beloved on the day of terror and grief.
Truly I love you, O month of fasting, without deceit: welcome then, and a greeting beyond number!
